top_choice_rationale: The magic-wavelength lattice is a distinct, independently reproduced measurement capability (agreement near 1e-18 across RIKEN/Tokyo, JILA, PTB, SYRTE and NIST), different in kind from the 2005 comb and the 2012 single-ion control. The two-name allocation to Katori (concept and first strontium demonstrations) and Ye (accuracy and stability frontier, many-body physics) is compact and defensible in the citation. The fundamental-physics payoff is still mostly bounds, so the citation should rest on the invention and verified new regime, but that does not justify withholding the award.
